credits: Glaze original built-in image_gen nature artwork and authored live native identity. Reflected-infrared-inspired photographic interpretation.

Crisp calm reflected-light photographic detail, luminous pale foliage INSIDE its actual boundaries, moderate natural contrast and real surface modelling. Foliage is bright because of the photographic spectral treatment, not snow/frost/fungus/white paint or a coating.
